Name: Silencing Smite
Description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell’s duration, your attack deals an extra 1d6 thunder damage. Additionally, if the target is a creature, it must make a Wisdom saving throw or be silenced until the spell ends. While silenced, the creature cannot speak or vocally produce noise; if they attempt to cast a spell that requires verbal components, they fail to produce them. Each time the creature attempts to cast a spell, and at the end of each of their turns, they repeat the Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
